title: Global Oil Prices Drop as US and Iran Pause Military Strikes
subtitle: Diplomatic efforts continue while markets remain cautious about the future of energy supplies

summary.en: Oil prices fell sharply on Monday after a pause in military strikes between the United States and Iran. President Donald Trump suggested that diplomatic talks are underway, though Iran has denied seeking new negotiations. The Strait of Hormuz remains closed, keeping global energy markets in a state of uncertainty. Meanwhile, European nations are taking steps to lower fuel taxes to help citizens manage rising costs. The situation remains fragile as leaders weigh the benefits of diplomacy against the risk of renewed conflict.
summary.zh: 由於美國與伊朗之間的軍事打擊暫停，週一油價大幅下跌。川普總統暗示外交談判正在進行中，儘管伊朗否認尋求新的談判。荷莫茲海峽依然封鎖，使全球能源市場處於不確定狀態。與此同時，歐洲國家正採取措施降低燃料稅，以協助民眾應對不斷上漲的成本。隨著各國領袖權衡外交利益與衝突重啟的風險，局勢依然脆弱。

paragraphs.en: Global oil prices dropped significantly on Monday as markets reacted to a pause in military strikes between the United States and Iran. After weeks of rising costs, the price of Brent crude—the international standard for oil—fell by about 8% to below $88 a barrel. This change follows a period of intense fighting that had pushed prices toward $100 last week. Traders are hopeful that the current break in hostilities could prevent further damage to the global oil supply.
paragraphs.zh: 由於市場對美國與伊朗之間軍事打擊行動的暫停做出反應，全球油價於週一大幅下跌。在經歷數週的成本攀升後，作為國際油價基準的布蘭特原油價格下跌約百分之八，跌至每桶八十八美元以下。此一變化發生在一段激烈的交戰期之後，該交戰期曾將上週的油價推向一百美元大關。交易員們抱持希望，認為當前的敵對狀態中斷或許能避免全球石油供應遭受進一步損害。

paragraphs.en: The pause in fighting comes after 13 days of continuous strikes. According to The Guardian, US Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz stated that President Donald Trump decided to stop the attacks to allow more time for diplomacy. Some reports suggest that US military officials advised the President that the bombing campaign had reached its limit and that the military was running low on necessary supplies. However, the situation remains unclear. While President Trump told the media that the US was having "good talks" with Iran, Deutsche Welle reports that Iranian officials have denied seeking to resume formal negotiations with Washington.
paragraphs.zh: 此次戰鬥暫停發生在連續十三天的攻擊之後。根據《衛報 (The Guardian)》報導，美國駐聯合國大使華爾茲 (Mike Waltz) 表示，川普總統決定停止攻擊，以爭取更多外交空間。部分報導指出，美國軍方官員曾建議總統，轟炸行動已達極限，且軍方所需的必要物資正逐漸短缺。然而，局勢依然不明朗。儘管川普總統向媒體表示美國正與伊朗進行「良好的對話」，但德國之聲 (Deutsche Welle) 報導稱，伊朗官員否認尋求與華盛頓恢復正式談判。

paragraphs.en: Despite the pause in military action, the Strait of Hormuz—a vital route for oil tankers—remains closed. This closure continues to worry experts who fear that the current calm may not last. Ole Hvalbye, an analyst at SEB Research, noted that previous reports of progress have often failed to produce real results. John Evans, an analyst at PVM, added that oil prices might only continue to fall if there is a real drop in demand, rather than just a temporary "mini-ceasefire," which is an agreement to stop fighting for a short time.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管軍事行動暫停，但作為油輪重要航道的荷莫茲海峽依然處於封鎖狀態。此一封鎖持續令專家感到擔憂，他們擔心目前的平靜可能無法持久。北歐斯安銀行 (SEB Research) 的分析師赫瓦爾比 (Ole Hvalbye) 指出，過去關於進展的報導往往未能產生實質結果。PVM 的分析師伊凡斯 (John Evans) 補充說，唯有需求真正下降，油價才可能持續下跌，而非僅僅依靠短暫的「迷你停火」，即指為期短暫的停止交戰協議。

paragraphs.en: The economic impact of the conflict is being felt far beyond the Middle East. As oil prices rose last week, many countries faced the threat of higher inflation, which is a general increase in prices over time. In response, some central banks have considered raising interest rates to keep the economy stable. To help citizens, the Italian government announced a temporary reduction in taxes on diesel fuel. According to Deutsche Welle, Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni described this as a responsible response to a situation that Italy did not cause but must address. Germany had previously introduced similar tax cuts, though those measures expired at the end of June.
paragraphs.zh: 這場衝突帶來的經濟衝擊已遠遠超出中東地區。隨著上週油價上漲，許多國家面臨通貨膨脹（即物價隨時間普遍上漲）加劇的威脅。為此，部分中央銀行已考慮升息以維持經濟穩定。為了協助民眾，義大利政府宣布暫時調降柴油稅。根據德國之聲報導，總理梅洛尼 (Giorgia Meloni) 將此描述為對義大利雖非肇事者但必須應對之局勢所做出的負責任回應。德國先前也曾實施類似的減稅措施，但這些措施已於六月底到期。

paragraphs.en: Regional tensions also remain high. On Monday, Iraq’s government announced that it would investigate reports of drone attacks launched from its territory toward Saudi Arabia. The Iraqi government stated that it is committed to preventing its land from being used as a starting point for any attacks against neighboring countries. Iraq is home to several groups that are affiliated with Iran, which adds another layer of complexity to the regional conflict.
paragraphs.zh: 區域緊張局勢依然高漲。週一，伊拉克政府宣布將調查有關從其領土向沙烏地阿拉伯發動無人機攻擊的報導。伊拉克政府聲明，致力於防止其領土被用作對鄰國發動攻擊的起點。伊拉克境內有多個與伊朗結盟的組織，這為區域衝突增添了另一層複雜性。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the future of the region is uncertain. President Trump has warned that he will not allow much time for the diplomatic process to work, telling the media that the situation must move quickly or the strikes will restart. For now, the world is watching to see if the current pause will lead to a lasting solution or if the conflict will flare up again. Analysts at Deutsche Bank have warned that if energy costs remain high, the global economy could face a long period of inflation, which might force central banks to take even stronger action. As the situation evolves, governments and businesses are preparing for the possibility that the current stability may be short-lived.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，該地區的前景仍不明朗。川普總統已警告，他不會給予外交進程太多時間，並向媒體表示局勢必須迅速推進，否則攻擊將會重啟。目前，全世界都在關注當前的暫停是否會帶來持久的解決方案，或是衝突將再次爆發。德意志銀行 (Deutsche Bank) 的分析師警告，若能源成本持續居高不下，全球經濟可能面臨長期的通貨膨脹，這可能迫使各國央行採取更強硬的行動。隨著局勢演變，各國政府與企業正為當前的穩定可能轉瞬即逝的可能性做好準備。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To have only a small amount of something left.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此片語常被誤解為「跑得很低」，實際上是指資源或物資即將耗盡。文中：some military officials advised the President that the bombing campaign had reached its limit and that the military was running low on necessary supplies.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To suddenly start or become much worse (used for violence, conflict, or illness).
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意思為「火焰噴發」，這裡引申為衝突再次升級。文中：For now, the world is watching to see if the current pause will lead to a lasting solution or if the conflict will flare up again.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Lasting for only a short period of time.
keyTerms.noteZh: 由 short 和 live 組成，容易被誤解為「短命的」，在商業或經濟語境中常用於形容某種狀態無法持久。文中：As the situation evolves, governments and businesses are preparing for the possibility that the current stability may be short-lived.

quiz.question: What is the primary reason mentioned for the recent drop in global oil prices?

options.A: A significant decrease in global demand for oil.
options.B: A temporary pause in military hostilities between the US and Iran.
options.C: The reopening of the Strait of Hormuz to oil tanker traffic.
options.D: New tax reduction policies introduced by the Italian government.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，油價下跌是因為市場對美伊之間軍事衝突暫停做出的反應。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章第三段提到分析師認為油價要持續下跌需要真正的需求減少，而非目前的情況。選項 C 錯誤，因為第三段明確指出荷姆茲海峽仍然關閉。選項 D 錯誤，這是義大利政府為了應對高油價帶來的衝擊而採取的措施，並非油價下跌的原因。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the current reduction in oil prices be considered fragile?

options.A: Because the US military has officially declared that they have run out of supplies.
options.B: Because Iran has already agreed to resume formal negotiations with Washington.
options.C: Because the underlying causes of the conflict remain unresolved and the ceasefire is limited.
options.D: Because the Italian and German governments have already ended their tax cut programs.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第三段與第六段，分析師指出目前的停火僅是短期的，且荷姆茲海峽仍處於封鎖狀態，加上川普總統威脅若外交進展不順將重啟攻擊，顯示衝突隨時可能再起。選項 A 錯誤，因為軍事供應短缺僅是報導中的推測，並非官方定論。選項 B 錯誤，文章第二段提到伊朗官員否認尋求恢復談判。選項 D 錯誤，這與油價波動的脆弱性無直接因果關係。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'flare' mean in the context of the sentence: '...see if the current pause will lead to a lasting solution or if the conflict will flare up again'?

options.A: To shine with a sudden, bright light.
options.B: To suddenly become violent or intense.
options.C: To expand in width or size gradually.
options.D: To signal for help using pyrotechnics.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在文中 'flare up' 用於描述衝突或暴力事件突然爆發或惡化。選項 A 是該詞的字面意思，但在描述衝突時不適用。選項 C 雖有擴大之意，但無法精確表達衝突突然加劇的動態感。選項 D 雖然 'flare' 可指信號彈，但在本句語境中明顯是指戰爭或衝突的重新爆發，而非實體的照明工具。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the central message of the article?

options.A: The US and Iran have reached a permanent diplomatic agreement to end their conflict.
options.B: Global oil prices are primarily determined by the tax policies of European nations.
options.C: Military conflicts in the Middle East have caused permanent damage to the global economy.
options.D: Despite a brief pause in military action, economic and regional instability continues to threaten the global market.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。整篇文章探討了美伊衝突對油價的影響，雖然目前有短暫停火，但文中多處提到外交進展的不確定性、荷姆茲海峽的封鎖以及通膨風險，顯示整體局勢仍不穩定。選項 A 與文意完全相反。選項 B 過度簡化，稅收政策僅是應對措施而非主因。選項 C 錯誤，文中並未斷言損害是「永久性」的，而是強調未來的不確定性。
